scope: Conducting settled H/He layers with trace metals up to Z=0.001. Source anchors and transport uncertainty limit remain required.

ionization.scope: Ionization diagnostic at the current1419K star and cooler projections, using the source GS98 metal proxy. H/He ionization is checked separately from the metal electron deficit; partial metal ionization remains an approximation. This diagnostic does not validate conductivity accuracy, liquid phase stability or the source free-energy error.

stellar_comparison.scope: Same255Myr interval, same saved state and all stellar settings. Only conducting-envelope maximumZ1e-4 to1e-3 changes. Source anchors, same free-energy formula, numerical settings, opacity uncertainty and transport bounds retained.

limitations: Partial metal ionization remains a conductivity approximation.
These controls do not validate crystallization or the total cooling-age error.
